limited by distortion (mis-
match) and by noise are
given in the graph in this

tion required to carry out a

ADC, ...) at a certain fre-
quency is plotted versus the

The curves are calculated

A number of experimental

They are taken from papers

It is clear that mismatch data presents a more realistic estimate of the power/frequency ratio
